engine_module.purpose: Map cranio-thoracic pain and dysfunction to embryological field modules — pharyngeal arch → cranial nerve bus → gate organ → segmental fascia-neuro-vascular unit. Output: symptom → gate → axis → reset strategy.
engine_module.core_principle: The pharyngeal arch system is an ecto-endo shunt cranio-visceral gateway series. Neural crest migration builds segmental fascia-neuro-vascular sensory units (resonance boxes). These modules operate with minimal mesodermal buffer, making them easily overstimulated. Clinical output is not an anatomy list — it is identification of which module is oscillating and through which gate it connects to visceral organs.
engine_module.field_principle: Pain = oscillating resonance box (unstable module), not a single structure. We treat the module oscillation, not the nerve.

notes: Batch 3 introduces the Pharyngeal Arch Engine — a developmental field module that underpins cranio-thoracic pain triage. This is a new top-level engine, not a sub-pattern of previous batches.
The engine uses embryological architecture (arch → CN → gate organ → resonance box) rather than symptom labels. Symptom → gate → axis → reset strategy is the algorithmic flow.

The Cranial Nerve Pain Module Map (12 CNs) is a complete reference table for all cranial nerve pain domains with arch affiliation, vascular driver, plexus, EZ collapse pathology, and intervention hint.
The 4-gate laser stellate protocol for arm CRPS is a concrete clinical protocol — store as a named device protocol object.
The resonance box model (L1-L4 algorithm) is a reusable clinical decision loop applicable to any segmental unit — pharyngeal or spinal.
The Developmental Engine data model (object types, relationships, UI toggles) is provided in app-build-ready format — directly implementable in Base44.
The pouch sensor corridor ('fish mouth model') is a conceptual framework explaining why pharyngeal-level problems simultaneously affect autonomic, immune, and endocrine systems.
Thyroid = ventral field descent node — clinical rule: thyroid dysfunction always check TMJ, neck fascia, sternum, vagus tone as co-patterns (all share embryological field).
Hashimoto clinical caution: multifactorial — field model supports co-pattern identification but does NOT imply emotional causation.
3 new herbs introduced in Batch 3: Gou Teng, Gua Lou Pi, Huang Qi, Suan Zao Ren, Long Yan Rou, Di Gu Pi, Huang Qin, Zhu Ling, Ban Xia.

Cross-batch linkages: Batch 1 migraine phenotypes → Batch 3 Arch 1 module (temporal migraine); Batch 2 pelvic EZ grid → Batch 3 caudal segmentation continuation; Batch 2 NSMBP → Batch 3 Du meridian / BL line as caudal arch continuation.
